summary: Revision 1 correctly returned HUMAN_REQUIRED because no repository-held or independently accessible evidence established a Fate Line break/overlap reading, and external primary-source lookup was blocked by this environment's network proxy. The Director independently verified a narrow Cheiro evidence boundary from Palmistry for All (1916) and recorded it at .ai-ops/evidence/PP-RELAY-048-cheiro-fate-line-break.md. Revision 2 drafted the approved Next 25 companion article directly against that controlling evidence and added src/content/blog/beginner/broken-fate-line-meaning.md (item 19 from docs/editorial-backlog.md's Next 25 list, 70 -> 71 published blog posts). The article opens by distinguishing absence (no fate line, covered in no-fate-line-meaning.md) from interruption (a break), then observation vocabulary for clean vs. overlapping breaks, before covering the two verified Cheiro readings: a generally broken/piecemeal line associated with troubles/breaks and lack of settled or continuous success, and the narrower overlapping-break configuration associated with a complete change in surroundings and position, with the conditional advancement reading kept attached to its 'good and straight' condition. A dedicated section explicitly declines every unsupported extension the task packet flagged (career/life-change generalization, smooth/planned/managed/gradual/beneficial transition, shifted-restart-means-new-field or multiple-life-chapters claims, gap-size scaling, timing/outcome claims, and synthesis with mounts or other lines), and an observation/history/site-policy section keeps the three claim types explicitly separate. Added one reciprocal-link sentence to fate-line.md's existing 'Breaks and interruptions' paragraph; the pillar's own pre-existing unsupported 'planned/smoother transition' wording was left untouched and logged as a follow-up cleanup item, along with a similar legacy defect in no-fate-line-meaning.md's 'Broken or fragmented fate line' paragraph, per this task's instruction not to expand scope into the canonical pillar or sibling articles. Updated docs/editorial-backlog.md (published count + row 19), docs/CHANGELOG.md, and docs/source-verification-log.md (Pass 15, full claim-level evidence map and preflight disposition).

source_preflight.notes: Full claim-by-claim disposition is recorded in docs/source-verification-log.md under 'Pass 15 -- Broken Fate Line Meaning companion article, revision 2'. No text is presented as a verbatim Cheiro quotation; both evidence-based readings are paraphrased, consistent with the controlling evidence note itself being a paraphrase. Direct observation, Cheiro's named historical interpretation, and Palmistry Path's own non-deterministic editorial policy are kept in separate, explicitly labeled statements throughout, including a dedicated 'Observation, history, and site policy' section. Two pre-existing legacy defects outside this task's scope (fate-line.md's 'planned/smoother transition' wording and no-fate-line-meaning.md's 'multiple chapters' wording) were identified and logged for a later bounded cleanup rather than fixed here.
